//Google: Sign in with Google. ClientIds are the OAuth client ids a Google ID token may be minted for (first the Web application client id, which the website and the Android app both request tokens for; second the Android client id, accepted too so a token addressed to it is never refused). Empty switches the feature off; supply it as Google__ClientIds__0 in the environment.
